home.headline: Institutional intelligence for evaluating companies and startups.
home.lede: AzevsmAI Systems develops and operates AzevsmAI — a structured evaluation platform combining standardized assessment, traceable analytics and proprietary AzeVSM AI.
home.heroNote: The platform is separate from this corporate website.
home.visualCaption: Visual representation of a structured analytical system.
home.problemTitle: There is more data than there is structured, defensible comparison.
home.problemBody: Company and startup information is often fragmented, heterogeneous and drawn from different sources. AzevsmAI is designed not merely to summarize it, but to organize it into a structured, traceable evaluation process.
home.systemTitle: A controlled path from evidence to a traceable result.
home.aiTitle: A proprietary intelligence architecture. Governed application.
home.aiBody: AzeVSM AI is a governed, source-bound architecture in which evaluation logic belongs to AzevsmAI Systems. Where external model or provider infrastructure is used, it does not define the methodology or final scoring authority.
home.aiBoundary: AI does not invent the result and is not the authority for the evaluation.
home.whiteBoxTitle: Explain the result. Protect the method.
home.whiteBoxBody: White Box explains the permitted basis of a result without exposing formulas, thresholds, internal variables or protected methodology.
home.standardTitle: A standardized approach. Consistent rules. A traceable result.
home.standardBody: The Azevsm Standard defines methodological and disclosure discipline across products and evaluations.
home.trustBody: Evidence, structure, governed evaluation, reproducibility and separation of result from explanation form one trust framework.
home.audienceTitle: Institutional evaluation infrastructure for companies and startups.
home.audienceBody: AzevsmAI products are designed for professional and institutional scenarios that require structured evaluation of companies and startups.
home.companyBody: AzevsmAI Systems develops and operates the AzevsmAI platform and AzeVSM AI architecture.
home.closingTitle: Ready to learn more about structured evaluation?
home.closingBody: Contact us about products, platform access, partnerships or human support.

vsm.title: Verifiable Structured Model
vsm.headline: From complex information to a verifiable analytical result.
vsm.lede: AzevsmAI VSM is not a free-form answer generator. It is an analytical platform that separates evidence, data structure, calculation, result and subsequent explanation.
vsm.statement: AzevsmAI turns data about an object not into an AI opinion, but into a verifiable analytical state.
does: Does not turn unsupported information into fact
Applies the calculation logic of the relevant product
Forms a fixed and reproducible result
Presents the result through reports, analytical models and controlled explanation
vsm.aiTitle: AI does not own the result
vsm.aiLede: What is not verified does not become true simply because AI can fill the gap.
vsm.aiBody: AI may support information processing and explanation of an already formed result, but it must not create unsupported facts or a new calculated result.
vsm.modelTitle: Analytical model of the assessed object
vsm.modelBody: The assessed object moves from a collection of fragmented documents into a structured analytical model of supported characteristics, constraints, dimensions and admissible relationships.
vsm.orderBody: Interpretation, visualization and presentation are not used to recalculate or arbitrarily alter the result.
vsm.accessBody: AzevsmAI VSM operates on a separate platform domain and is not merged into the corporate website.

products.headline: Independent analytical product families.
products.lede: AzevsmAI products are not different names for the same result. Each product has its own purpose, analytical logic and form of result.
indexPoints: Index Standard — a complete high-quality baseline result
Index Premium — deeper analytical presentation within the same result family
Greater depth of presentation does not create new mathematics or a new result
products.instLede: An independent product for professional and institutional evaluation.
products.instNote: Specific sector coverage is published only after separate confirmation.

index.headline: Structured index assessment and a verifiable result.
index.lede: AzevsmAI Index provides structured index assessment and a clear analytical presentation of the result.
index.premiumBody: Deeper analytical presentation within the same result family.
index.note: Greater depth of presentation does not create new mathematics or a new result.

institutional.label: Institutional analytics
institutional.headline: Beyond the report: an explorable analytical model of the result.
institutional.lede: Institutional Index is an independent AzevsmAI VSM product for professional and institutional assessment scenarios.
institutional.flow: Result → 4 dimensions → Digital Analytical Model → IIT 3D → Report / Evidence / Traceability
institutional.damLede: A report records the conclusion. A Digital Analytical Model lets you explore its structure.
institutional.damBody: The Digital Analytical Model preserves the result, analytical dimensions, supported characteristics, constraints and relationships in one digital analytical environment.
institutional.iitLede: IIT 3D is the space of the verified structure of the result.
institutional.iitBody: IIT 3D moves the result from a sequence of pages into an explorable analytical space. The model does not complete the object or create decorative relationships; it shows only the structure AzevsmAI has grounds to assert.
institutional.iitNote: IIT 3D is positioned as a flagship Institutional Index capability. Client delivery depends on package level and is not an automatic part of Standard.
institutional.whiteLede: Explain the result. Protect the method.
institutional.whiteBody: WhiteBox is a controlled explainability mechanism that helps users understand the permitted basis of a result without exposing protected methodology.
institutional.whiteNote: WhiteBox is not presented as an automatically available feature for every client. Availability and depth depend on the authorized disclosure level.
institutional.boundaryBody: Specific sector and object coverage of Institutional Index is published only after separate confirmation.

plus.headline: Seven specialized services. Seven independent analytical results.
plus.lede: AzevsmAI Plus consists of independent specialized services for analyzing specific aspects of a company, project or organization.
plus.each: Each service has its own domain, calculation logic and standalone result.
plus.independenceBody: Plus services do not replace or mix Index or Institutional Index results and do not create one combined seven-service result.
plus.presentationBody: Each service forms its own result, which is explained only within the approved subject and analytical boundaries of that service.
plus.asProduct: Each service is presented as an independent product.

trust.headline: Verifiable result. Controlled explanation. Protected method.
trust.lede: Trust in AzevsmAI VSM is built not on interface transparency alone, but on the discipline by which the result is formed.
trust.order: The result is formed and fixed first. It may then be explained, explored and visualized.
trust.explainBody: WhiteBox explains the permitted basis of a result without exposing internal formulas, parameters or protected methodology.
trust.validationBody: A public validation section may state that control series demonstrated reproducibility across independent executions. Company names, logos and specific scores are not published without a separate legal decision.

technology.headline: AzevsmAI VSM is built on a proprietary scientific and technical methodology.
technology.lede: The methodology is designed for structured analytical assessment of complex objects under uncertainty and information asymmetry.
technology.purpose: AzevsmAI is not designed to generate more text. It is designed to form a justified analytical result.
technology.protectedBody: The website explains the purpose and principles of the methodology, but does not expose formulas, weights, internal variables, calculation rules or technical details that could enable reconstruction of protected logic.

iit3d.headline: The space of the verified structure of the result.
iit3d.lede: IIT 3D is an explorable analytical space of the verified structure of the result. It moves the result from a sequence of pages into a digital environment where structure, dimensions, constraints and supported relationships can be explored.
iit3d.body: The model does not complete the object or create decorative relationships; it shows only the structure AzevsmAI has grounds to assert.
iit3d.note: IIT 3D is positioned as a flagship Institutional Index capability. Client delivery depends on package level and is not an automatic part of Standard.
iit3d.visualCaption: A spatial reading of verified structure — not a generated scene, and not a substitute for the result.

sections.title: Operator
sections.body: The website is operated by AzevsmAI Systems. Contact: contact@azevsmai.systems.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: The contact form may collect name, email, organization, subject and message. There are no user accounts on this website.

sections.title: How messages are handled
sections.body: When an email provider is connected, inquiries are sent to the published contact address. Until then, write directly to that address. Do not send passwords, credentials or protected methodology through the form.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.body: Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights may be used. They are cookieless audience and performance measurements, not advertising profiles.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Contact messages are kept only as long as needed to respond and operate the company. We do not sell personal data.
